title: Linh Phước Temple

buildingCutout.basis: Replacing the exact named mapped volume of Linh Tháp while preserving other site buildings.

terrainReference.basis: Original elevation at the roadside approach in front of Linh Tháp.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap named Linh Phước bell tower, Buddhist site and worship building ways
mapIdentity.scope: The named 19-vertex bell tower way matches Wikidata Q10748461. The adjacent mapped religious site and worship buildings establish the neighboring exterior envelope. The provincial and national tourism records establish the 37 m bell tower height, superseding the lower map tag.

note: Diane Selwyn’s 2011 public-domain Qualla photograph establishes the historic dark upturned roofs, ornamented central bays, flanking lower roof towers and the stacked bell tower sequence. The 37 m height and seven levels follow the national tourism authority and provincial gazetteer.
